body.name: Full-cell exchangeable square-root selected Gaussian experiment
body.construction: For each fixed label \(C\), first draw the stage-1 Gaussian blocks independently across \(t\in S\): \(X_t\sim\mathcal N(A_t\sqrt{1-\rho}h_t,1)\), and for each active \(j=(C,s)\in J\), \((X_s,R_{1j})\) has correlation \(\kappa_j\sqrt{1-\rho}\) and mean \((A_s\sqrt{1-\rho}h_s,b_{1j}h_s)\). Realize the signed cell from the inequalities \(X_t>c_t\). Conditional on obtaining \(C\), draw \(R_{2j}\sim\mathcal N(b_{2j}h_s,1)\) independently across active strata and independently of all stage-1 blocks. Thus, for active \(j=(C,s)\), the chronological triple has covariance \(\begin{psmallmatrix}1&\kappa_j\sqrt{1-\rho}&0\\\kappa_j\sqrt{1-\rho}&1&0\\0&0&1\end{psmallmatrix}\), and its selected law is restricted and normalized to \(E_C=\bigcap_{t:C_t=1}\{X_t>c_t\}\cap\bigcap_{t:C_t=0}\{X_t\le c_t\}\).
